script_text: Stop! Gemini, Jupiter is finally aligning with your airy, Mercury-ruled chart, and you simply cannot ignore this cosmic signal. The Sun and your ruling planet Mercury sit in your 7th House of Partnerships, forming a golden sextile aspect to Jupiter in your 1st House of Self and identity. Singles feel an electric spark through Venus in Sagittarius, pulling a stranger with serious intentions into your life; if taken, guard against overcommitting emotionally to a new partner before knowing their deeper truth. Career-wise, transiting Saturn sits heavy in your 9th House of Law and Travel, so pause firmly before signing any important legal contract today. Avoid exaggerating your skills in meetings, or trust will shatter quickly and unexpectedly in public. Instead, embrace one very sudden travel opportunity as your unexpected gift. Follow for tomorrow's reading before Jupiter shifts your luck again.
